author: Nuon Bonong
changelog: Grade 9 Worksheets, Quizzes, & Question Bank complete upgrade: audited all mathematical typesetting (zero raw slash fractions, standardized \dfrac, fixed \ldots and KaTeX math delimiters, converted currency signs to \text{ ដុល្លារ}); strictly aligned exercises with MoEYS curriculum progression across all 18 lessons (78 points) from Chapter 1 to Chapter 4 (Diploma exam prep); added 78 Level 3 exercises (កម្រិត ៣: ពិបាក / គិតស៊ីជម្រៅ និងដោះស្រាយបញ្ហា) completing 3 distinct difficulty levels per point totaling 234 comprehensive exercises with detailed teacher solutions, rubrics, and dynamic score calculation (/ ៣); audited 830 point quiz questions and 845 question bank questions for zero math typography errors.
